lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The mid-body lateral flank displays a semi-regular grid of high-intensity white spots arranged in roughly vertical columns. Each column contains 4 to 6 identifiable centroids, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the central third of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal alignment of the spots. These intersections form distinct nodes where the spot intensity is maximized against the darker background pigmentation.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where the superior edge reflects ambient light and the inferior edge is in shadow, creating a distinct linear edge effect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 7 to 10 small, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated towards the basal and posterior regions of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least three commensal fish (remoras) is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region, immediately posterior to the insertion point of the left pectoral fin.
